decks.notes: This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on putting early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Badgermole Cub and Ygra, Eater of All, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay to control the board. Utilizing Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven for additional value and life gain, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of cards like Gilded Goose and Cache Grab allows for ramping and card advantage, while cards like Scavenger's Talent and Dredger's Insight provide further card selection and graveyard interaction. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck is focused on aggressively attacking the opponent with low-cost spells and creatures to quickly deal damage. It relies on cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Emberheart Challenger to deal consistent damage while using spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board. The deck also includes cards like Sleight of Hand and Academic Dispute to draw into more threats and maintain card advantage. The mana base is built around red and blue sources, enabling the deck to cast its spells efficiently and consistently.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a synergistic win condition. It utilizes various tutors and control elements like Bitter Triumph and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes ramp and mana fixing cards like Multiversal Passage and Agadeem's Awakening to ensure a smooth and consistent gameplay. By carefully managing resources and setting up the combo, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful and unbeatable combination of creatures and abilities.

The deck revolves around using powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Badgermole Cub alongside disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sentinel of the Nameless City provide additional threats and value. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy, with key lands like Mutavault and Overgrown Tomb. The deck aims to grind out opponents with a combination of creature beatdown and disruption, ultimately overwhelming them with its versatile tools.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategies through a combination of counter spells, removal, and hand disruption. The addition of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and card advantage through flickering permanents. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hopeless Nightmare. With a mix of lands that provide different colors of mana, the deck is able to consistently cast its spells and maintain control of the game.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then using that mana to play powerful creatures like Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu and Badgermole Cub. The deck also includes cards like Enduring Vitality to protect your creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate even more mana. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and efficient mana usage.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also efficiently dealing with threats on the board using cards like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay. The creatures in the deck, such as Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, provide additional value and pressure to help close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to deliver fast and consistent damage to the opponent, utilizing cheap spells and efficient creatures. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Reckless Rage and Burst Lightning while dealing direct damage with Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage. Academic Dispute and Boomerang Basics provide additional versatility and disruption. The deck's mana base is structured to ensure that spells can be cast efficiently and quickly, maximizing pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive tactics to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and spells. By using cards like Thundering Broodwagon, Formidable Speaker, and Greasefang, Okiba Boss, you can create a formidable board presence that is difficult to deal with. The inclusion of Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality allows you to disrupt your opponent's game plan while setting up your own win condition. The deck also utilizes cards like Agadeem's Awakening and Multiversal Passage to ensure you have the necessary mana to cast your spells.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells while also utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also has some land cards that provide additional benefits, such as Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber and Mutavault. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining board control and outvaluing the opponent with a mix of removal, disruption, and threats.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption, board control, and resource denial. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while slowly building up its own advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents like Cryogen Relic and Clearwater Pathway. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and outlasting the opponent to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells in order to quickly diminish their life total. By utilizing cards such as Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Burst Lightning, you can apply early pressure while maintaining card advantage with Sleight of Hand and Experimental Synthesizer. Additionally, the deck features disruptive spells like Boomerang Basics and Reckless Rage to control the board and keep opponents on the defensive. With a mix of burn, prowess creatures, and card filtering, this UR Aggro deck aims to outpace opponents and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive red creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By efficiently using efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Monastery Swiftspear, and Soul-Scar Mage, along with direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game as fast as possible. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional sources of damage, while cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage offer ways to pump up creatures for extra damage. The deck prioritizes speed and efficiency in order to win before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively get Arclight Phoenix onto the battlefield, utilizing spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe to trigger its ability. The deck also includes cards like Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster for additional card draw and damage. With a heavy emphasis on spells and card draw, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of powerful spells and creatures while maintaining card advantage through cards like Opt and Treasure Cruise. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells.

This Control deck focuses on utilizing counterspells, board wipes, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, while gradually building up its own resources and advantage. The deck includes a variety of counterspells like Dovin's Veto and Narset, Parter of Veils, as well as board wipes like Supreme Verdict. Card draw spells such as Memory Deluge and Consult the Star Charts help the player dig through their deck for key cards. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to control the game through spell interactions and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Divide by Zero, Accumulate Wisdom, and Tablet of Discovery, the player can manipulate the board state and draw cards to maintain control. The addition of powerful creatures like Thor, God of Thunder and Questing Druid provide threats on the board while Gran-Gran offers additional control elements. The deck utilizes a mix of red and blue lands to ensure consistent mana production for its spells and creatures.
